{{Quote|All power comes from the Great Wind.|Kharys|<ref name="Skyewalkers" />}}
The '''Great Wind''' was the chief [[Deity/Legends|deity]] of the [[S'kytri]], the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. According to the S'kytri's [[S'kytri mythology|beliefs]], their [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was originally ruled by chaotic monstruosities, with the exception of the heavens above. Consequently, the Great Wind [[Reproduction/Legends|mated]] with [[Canaitith Mountain]], the tallest peak on Skye, siring the S'kytri in order to defeat the fiendish creatures that ruled over the world below.<ref name="Skyewalkers" />

The S'kytri believed that all forms of power came from the Great Wind. For that reason, the mystic energy that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] called [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was known to them as "the power of the Great Wind." At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the S'kytri [[Parent/Legends|parents]] who produced abherrant hatchling would sometimes offer them in sacrifice to the Great Wind at [[Mount Krisklar]].<ref name="Skyewalkers" />
